title: A model for system developers to measure the privacy risk of data
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a model to measure users' perceived privacy risk related to data disclosure in software systems. While privacy is an ethical concern, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark specific ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/faith-based perspectives as its core contribution. The mention of an "ethics committee" is standard for human subject research and not indicative of the paper's core subject being ethics evaluation.
